en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad, from Muhammad Bin Al Hassan Bin Shamoun, from Abdullah Bin Abdul Rahman Al Asamma, from Misma’a,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> that they came to Amir Al-Momineen<sup>asws</sup> with an atheist, so he<sup>asws</sup> struck his neck’.
